messages:
sophie: Quick note - ran into a strange 'default is not a function' when bundling the JS SDK for edge with Vite+esbuild.
alex: Can you paste minimal repro steps?
sophie: Minimal repro:\n1) package.json has { \"type\": \"module\" }\n2) import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'\n3) vite build --ssr --target=esnext\n4) deploy to edge runtime (Cloudflare Worker)
Observed error at runtime: TypeError: Redwood.default is not a function
matt: Sounds like ESM namespace interop - bundler emitted a namespace object where callers expect a direct default export. What does your package export map look like?
sophie: package.json exports point to ./dist/index.mjs for import and ./dist/index.cjs for require. dist/index.mjs was: export * from './lib/core.js'; export { default } from './lib/core.js';
jules: Re-exporting default in that style can trigger bundlers to generate a wrapped namespace. esbuild sometimes outputs nested default properties depending on transform and target.
alex: Did you try explicitly importing then re-exporting the default instead of using export { default } from ... ?
sophie: Yes - replacing dist/index.mjs with:\nimport core from './lib/core.js'\nexport default core\nexport * from './lib/core.js'\nfixed the Vite repro in my test app. Worker saw a callable default again.
matt: Good catch. Also add a small CJS shim in the published CJS build like module.exports = exports.default || exports to help require() consumers.
jules: Heads-up: Type definitions also regressed for some consumers because index.d.ts didn't re-export lib types. TS users saw errors like 'generate' not found on the imported namespace.
sophie: Proposed fixes in my draft PR: explicit ESM wrapper entry, CJS interop glue, and an index.d.ts that re-exports everything from ./lib/core. Added an examples/edge-vite-min-repro to demonstrate.
devx-bot: nightly-smoke:edge-bundler-compat failed for examples/edge-vite-min-repro (CI logs attached)
alex: We should add CI that builds tiny example apps with Vite, Rollup, and Webpack targeting SSR/edge and runs them against a worker shim to catch runtime-only failures.
matt: Also confirm Rollup/webpack behavior - Rollup output might work in Node but fail in Workers due to subtle runtime differences.
sophie: Confirmed: Rollup worked in Node but failed when deployed to the Worker runtime. Vite/esbuild produced issues in both environments without the explicit wrapper.
jules: Short-term workaround for users: import the implementation file directly: import { default as Redwood } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/lib/core.js' until the publish fixes land.
alex: Action items: eng/devex land wrapper (sophie), eng/build add CJS glue and correct types generation, eng/platform add worker-shim CI, docs add \"Edge bundler gotchas\".
sophie: I'll update the PR with the types fix and CI job. If anyone hits similar symptoms, drop bundler + build flags + runtime here and we'll expand the triage matrix. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
